canonical_url.description: Published URL of this dashboard for JSON-LD provenance. Default: <slug>.html (relative).

publisher_url.description: JSON-LD publisher org URL. Default: the rapidmeta-kit Pages site.

orcid.description: Author ORCID (id or full URL). Omit to drop the empty identifier.

repo.description: owner/repo cited in the help text. Default: mahmood726-cyber/rapidmeta-kit.

nct.description: Trial registry ID. Auto-linked ONLY for recognized formats (NCT########, ISRCTN########, ACTRN##############). Any other ID must be paired with an explicit 'sourceUrl' or the build fails closed (clone.py refuses to fabricate a clinicaltrials.gov link from an arbitrary string).

sourceUrl.description: Explicit registry/source URL for the trial. REQUIRED when 'nct' is not a recognized auto-linked registry ID (e.g. EU-CTR, PACTR, ChiCTR, jRCT).
